title: Add Data Table
content: Create data table with sorting and filtering. Table container: overflow-x-auto for mobile scroll. Table: w-full border-collapse. Header: sticky top-0 bg-gray-50, th with px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider. Sort buttons: inline-flex items-center gap-1, show arrow icons for asc/desc. Body rows: hover:bg-gray-50 transition. Cells: px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap. Filter row: search input above table. Pagination: flex justify-between items-center, prev/next buttons, page numbers, items per page selector.

variants.simple: Create sortable, filterable data table with pagination.
variants.detailed: Create data table with sorting and filtering. Table container: overflow-x-auto for mobile scroll. Table: w-full border-collapse. Header: sticky top-0 bg-gray-50, th with px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider. Sort buttons: inline-flex items-center gap-1, show arrow icons for asc/desc. Body rows: hover:bg-gray-50 transition. Cells: px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap. Filter row: search input above table. Pagination: flex justify-between items-center, prev/next buttons, page numbers, items per page selector.
variants.advanced: Create full-featured data table component. Container: relative overflow-hidden rounded-lg border. Toolbar: flex justify-between p-4 border-b, contains search input, column visibility toggle, export button. Search: debounced input with search icon, searches across all columns. Column visibility: dropdown with checkboxes for each column. Sorting: click header to sort, shift+click for multi-sort, sort indicators (▲▼). Filtering: per-column filters in header row, text/select/date range based on column type. Selection: checkbox column, select all (current page/all), bulk action bar appears when items selected. Row actions: hover to show action buttons (edit, delete, view) or use dropdown menu. Expandable rows: click to expand additional details. Resizable columns: drag border to resize. Sticky columns: first column stays visible on horizontal scroll. Loading state: skeleton rows or overlay spinner. Empty state: centered message when no data. Pagination: page size selector (10/25/50/100), page number buttons with ellipsis, showing X-Y of Z items. Keyboard navigation: arrow keys to navigate, Enter to select, Escape to deselect. Virtual scrolling: for large datasets, only render visible rows. Export: CSV/Excel download of filtered data.
